packages/memory/src/lonora_memory/__init.name: Memory package
packages/memory/src/lonora_memory/__init.description: Marks the memory code as one package; holds no logic of its own.

packages/memory/src/lonora_memory/commit.name: Save memory
packages/memory/src/lonora_memory/commit.description: Saves a batch of memory changes all-or-nothing, keeping owner preferences in the shared profile and out of an agent's own document.

packages/memory/src/lonora_memory/conver.name: Conversation recall
packages/memory/src/lonora_memory/conver.description: Lets an agent recall older messages from a conversation it is allowed to read.

packages/memory/src/lonora_memory/edits..name: Memory edits
packages/memory/src/lonora_memory/edits..description: Applies the individual edits to a memory document, refusing the whole batch if any part is wrong or the result is too large.

packages/memory/src/lonora_memory/eviden.name: Memory evidence
packages/memory/src/lonora_memory/eviden.description: Finds the most relevant memory for a query by blending word matches and meaning matches.

packages/memory/src/lonora_memory/guard..name: Memory guard
packages/memory/src/lonora_memory/guard..description: Refuses a standing instruction that would have the agent hand private data elsewhere.

packages/memory/src/lonora_memory/markdo.name: Memory formatting
packages/memory/src/lonora_memory/markdo.description: Normalizes memory text and prepares it for the agent's context.

packages/memory/src/lonora_memory/method.name: Agent method
packages/memory/src/lonora_memory/method.description: Keeps versioned copies of an agent's working method, so an older one can be restored without touching its other memory.

packages/memory/src/lonora_memory/profil.name: Memory views
packages/memory/src/lonora_memory/profil.description: Separates an agent's own memory from the shared owner profile and its named sections.

packages/memory/src/lonora_memory/retrie.name: Memory word-search
packages/memory/src/lonora_memory/retrie.description: Matches memory by words across languages, keeping technical terms exact.

packages/memory/src/lonora_memory/semant.name: Memory meaning-search
packages/memory/src/lonora_memory/semant.description: Finds memory by meaning, and keeps notes indexed as the owner edits them so an edit never leaves both the old and new note.

packages/memory/src/lonora_memory/sessio.name: History search
packages/memory/src/lonora_memory/sessio.description: Searches an agent's past conversations within what it is allowed to read.
